description: Small development set, including previously explored questions. Not held out; evidence annotations may not list every acceptable passage.

questions.question: What is insulin resistance?

evidence.quote: cells don't respond normally to insulin

questions.expected_behavior: Explain reduced cell response to insulin; cite evidence.

questions.question: What does it mean when cells stop responding properly to insulin?

evidence.quote: cells don't respond normally to insulin

questions.expected_behavior: Explain insulin resistance without adding unsupported mechanisms.

questions.question: What is inslin resistence?

questions.question: Can type 2 diabetes have no noticeable symptoms?

evidence.quote: Sometimes there aren't any noticeable symptoms at all

questions.expected_behavior: Yes, sometimes; preserve the qualification and cite evidence.

questions.question: Does type 2 diabetes occur only in adults?

evidence.quote: more and more children, teens , and young adults

questions.expected_behavior: No; the source describes younger people developing it too. Cite evidence.

questions.question: What kind of test can identify diabetes?
